product: AI football coach app that tracks your training, nutrition and sleep and builds a weekly plan around your position

banned_topics: negative framing of a named player, club or coach
rules.tone: A young player talking to other players, plain and direct, no coach-speak and no hype.

guidance.hook_style: A count plus a consequence: things killing your career, habits holding you back, ways to progress. Never a question.
angles: habits that hold a player back (sleep, junk food, only training when motivated, skipping recovery, comparing yourself)
ways to make quick progress (train daily and track it, nutrition, analyse your game, sleep, remember someone works harder)
what a pro does that you don't
notes: Pitchly appears once, mid-set, as a Bonus slide: what it tracked or showed
no readable club crests, names or numbers on shirts
the closer is the last numbered item
